args.subject: Free Consultation Request
args.body:
Hello,

I received your email about your event organizing services and would like to book the free consultation you mentioned. Please let me know what dates and times are available.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text: I emailed bookings@best-event-organizers.com to request the free consultation. That is the booking address given in the event organizers' email. I asked them to send their available dates and times. I'll leave it to you to look for their reply.
